help.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: It is coming in a future version of ArchipelaGOAT.
help.INVALID_INPUT: The app sent a malformed request. Try again; if it happens again, create a support bundle from the health check.
help.NOT_FOUND: The requested file or item no longer exists. It may have been moved or deleted.
help.PATH_FORBIDDEN: For your safety, the app only opens its own folders, Archipelago’s folders and a few known sites.
help.TASK_CANCELLED: You can start it again whenever you like.
help.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: This action only exists on Windows or only on Linux.
help.AP_NOT_INSTALLED: Install Archipelago 0.6.8 from the install screen, or tell the settings where your copy is.
help.AP_RUNNING: Close the open Archipelago programs (Launcher, clients, server), then try again.
help.AP_RUNNING_local-server: Stop the local server first, from the live game screen: a game is hosted in one place at a time. Then host it on archipelago.gg.
help.AP_RUNNING_generating: Wait for the generation to end (or cancel it), then start the server: the new seed would replace the one it serves.
help.AP_RUNNING_web-room: Starting it on this PC makes the app forget its room. Confirm it from the Host step of the wizard.
help.SETTINGS_LOCKED: Another program is using the settings file. Close Archipelago and try again.
help.SETTINGS_LOCKED_processes: These Archipelago programs are open and would save their own copy of the settings when they close: {{processes}}. Close them, then try again.
help.NETWORK_OFFLINE: Check your connection. Anything already cached is still available.
help.GITHUB_RATE_LIMITED: Too many anonymous requests. Wait a little, or add a GitHub token in the settings to raise the limit.
help.HTTP_ERROR: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, the site may be down.
help.DOWNLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH: Its checksum does not match the expected one, so the file was deleted. Download it again.
help.INSTALL_ELEVATION_DENIED: Archipelago’s installer needs your approval (the User Account Control prompt). Start the install again and accept the prompt.
help.INSTALL_FAILED: The log has the details. Try again; the health check can spot the cause.
help.INSTALL_FAILED_no-digest: GitHub gave no SHA-256 checksum for this file: only its size can be checked. Install it from the install screen once you accept that, or try again later.
help.WORLD_INVALID: An .apworld is a zip archive holding a world’s Python folder. Check that you downloaded the right file.
help.WORLD_INCOMPATIBLE: Look for a version of the world made for your Archipelago version, or update Archipelago.
help.WORLD_CORRUPT_BLOCKING: A corrupted APWorld keeps Archipelago from starting. Set it aside from the Worlds screen or the health check.
help.WORLD_CORRUPT_BLOCKING_file: {{file}} is a corrupted APWorld and keeps Archipelago from starting. Set it aside from the Worlds screen or the health check.
help.WORLD_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE: ArchipelaGOAT cannot find its .apworld file. Download it from its page: {{url}}, then install the downloaded file.
help.WORLD_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE_no-release: Its GitHub repository has published no stable release (only prereleases, or nothing). Download it from its page: {{url}}, then install the downloaded .apworld file.
help.WORLD_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE_no-apworld: Its latest GitHub release holds no .apworld file. See on its page how to get it: {{url}}, then install the downloaded file.
help.WORLD_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE_ambiguous: Its latest GitHub release holds several .apworld files, and none of them alone bears the name of the game. Pick the right one on its page: {{url}}, then install it.
help.YAML_PARSE: A syntax error prevents reading it (often a tab or a missing colon). Fix it in the studio.
help.GENERATION_PREFLIGHT: Some checks failed before starting. Fix the reported points in the Check step.
help.GENERATION_PREFLIGHT_hosting: Stop the local server from the live game screen, then generate again: the new game replaces the one it runs.
help.GENERATION_PREFLIGHT_game-in-progress: Generating again replaces the seed, its patches and the game’s save (or its archipelago.gg room). Confirm it from the Generate step of the wizard.
help.GENERATION_FAILED: Archipelago stopped on an error. The log has the details.
help.PROCESS_TIMEOUT: The program ran past its time limit and was stopped. Try again: a generation with many players can take a while.
help.PORT_IN_USE: Another server is probably running already. Stop it, or use another port.
help.SERVER_START_FAILED: The server log gives the cause. Fix it, then try again.
help.SERVER_START_FAILED_running: Its log gives the cause. Start it again: the game picks up from its last save.
help.SERVER_START_FAILED_orphan: ArchipelaGOAT was closed while this server ran: it still serves its players. Stop it to take it back, then start the game again from the wizard.
help.WEBHOST_UPLOAD_FAILED: The site rejected the game file. Try again, or host the game locally.
help.WEBHOST_UPLOAD_FAILED_message: archipelago.gg says: “{{message}}”. Try again, or host the game locally.
help.WEBHOST_UPLOAD_FAILED_too-large: The game’s zip is bigger than the site accepts: host it locally instead.
help.WEBHOST_ROOM_FAILED: archipelago.gg did not open a room for this game. Try again in a moment.
help.WEBHOST_UNAVAILABLE: The site is not responding right now. Try again later, or host the game locally.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE: ArchipelaGOAT could not read this game file. Generate the game again.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE_version: This game file has a format that ArchipelaGOAT does not know, so it was not read. Generate the game again with Archipelago 0.6.8.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE_size: This game file is far bigger than a game can be once unpacked, so it was not read. Generate the game again.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE_shape: This file does not hold the players’ locations of an Archipelago game. Use the file that the generation produced.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE_opcode: This game file holds data that an Archipelago game never has, so it was not read. Use the file that the generation produced.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE_truncated: This game file is cut short or damaged. Generate the game again.
help.MULTIDATA_UNREADABLE_depth: This game file is nested far deeper than an Archipelago game ever is, so it was not read. Use the file that the generation produced.
help.MEASURE_TIMEOUT: Archipelago did not finish this player’s test generation within 2 minutes, so it was stopped. Measure again, or check the player’s options in the studio.
help.CHECKS_NO_SCHEMA: Neither Archipelago nor archipelago.gg has an options template for this game, so ArchipelaGOAT can neither build its profiles nor suggest settings. Generate the templates in the studio, then try again.
help.JOIN_BAD_INPUT: Paste an archipelago.gg room link, an archipelago:// or host:port address, or drop a patch file.
help.PATCH_INVALID: It may be incomplete, or made for another version. Ask the organizer for it again.
help.ROM_MISSING: This game needs your ROM. Add it to the vault (Emulators and ROMs). ArchipelaGOAT never provides ROMs.
help.ROM_BAD_HASH: Its checksum does not match the version Archipelago expects (often the region or the revision). Use a dump of the right version.
help.BIZHAWK_PREREQ_MISSING: Install the components listed on the Emulators and ROMs screen, then try again.
help.SECRETS_UNAVAILABLE: The system keyring is not available. Allow plain-text storage in the settings, or enter the secret each time.
help.AP_YAML_INVALID: A player file has an error. Fix it in the studio, then generate again.
help.AP_WORLD_NOT_FOUND: Install this world from the Worlds screen, and check how the game is spelled in the YAML.
help.AP_NO_GAME_OPTIONS: The YAML picks this game but has no options section under its name. Open it in the studio to add one.
help.AP_QUANTITY_DISABLED: A YAML asks for several copies of the same player, which the host settings forbid. Remove the quantity from the YAML.
help.AP_VERSION_REQUIRED: A YAML asks for version {{required}}, and you have {{current}}. Update Archipelago or the world, or adjust the YAML.
help.AP_PLANDO_DISABLED: A YAML uses plando ({{module}}) but it is not enabled. Enable it in the game rules, or remove it from the YAML.
help.AP_NAMES_NOT_UNIQUE: Each slot needs a unique name. Rename one of the players in the Check step.
help.AP_FILL_UNBEATABLE: With these options, Archipelago found no item layout that lets everyone finish. Try again, or loosen the options.
help.AP_FILL_NO_SPOTS: {{count}} items have no location left. Add fewer items or more locations, then try again.
help.AP_FILL_NOT_ENOUGH_LOCATIONS: There is no room for {{count}} progression items. Adjust the options (fewer items, more locations), then try again.
help.AP_FILL_FAILED: Archipelago could not place every item. Try again; if it happens again, change the options.
help.AP_ROM_MISSING: Add the ROM to the vault (Emulators and ROMs), then try again. ArchipelaGOAT never provides ROMs.
help.AP_ROM_HASH: Archipelago does not recognize this ROM. Use a dump of the expected version.
help.AP_MULTIDATA_INCOMPATIBLE: This game file comes from an incompatible Archipelago version. Generate the game again, or use the same version.
help.AP_SERVER_TOO_OLD: The game needs a server at version {{required}} or newer, and this one runs {{current}}. Update Archipelago.
help.AP_NO_ARCHIPELAGO_IN_ZIP: The zip holds no .archipelago file. Use the zip that the generation produced.
help.AP_PORT_IN_USE: Another server already uses this port. Stop it, or use another port.
help.AP_UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. The technical details and the log can help, and so can the health check.

issues.yaml-syntax: YAML syntax error: check the indentation (spaces, no tabs) and the colons.
issues.duplicate-key: A key appears twice at the same level.
issues.encoding-fallback: The file was not UTF-8: it was read as Windows-1252. Check the accented letters.
issues.no-game: No game is chosen (the game key is missing).
issues.game-not-installed: No installed world handles this game.
issues.game-unconfirmed: No installed world declares this game, but a world without a manifest ({{worlds}}) may provide it: Archipelago will tell at generation.
issues.game-section-missing: The game’s options section is missing.
issues.game-section-null: The game’s options section is empty (null): write {} instead.
issues.name-too-long: The name is longer than 16 characters.
issues.name-numeric: The name cannot be made of digits only.
issues.name-duplicate: Another player already has this name.
issues.requires-version-format: The required version (requires) is not in x.y.z format.
issues.requires-version-too-new: This YAML asks for a newer Archipelago than yours.
issues.requires-plando-disabled: This YAML asks for a plando module that is not enabled.
issues.requires-game-version: This YAML asks for another version of the installed world.
issues.option-unknown: Unknown option for this game: it will be ignored.
issues.option-float: This option expects a whole number.
issues.weights-all-zero: Every weight of this option is 0: no value can be picked.
issues.quantity-disabled: Quantities above 1 are disabled on this host.
issues.root-common-option: This option sits at the root of the file: move it into the game section.
issues.plando-items-disabled: This YAML places items with plando, but item plando is not enabled.
issues.not-yaml-file: This file is not a YAML file.
issues.world-no-manifest: This world has no manifest: it will stop working with Archipelago 0.7.
issues.world-version-conflict: Another version of this world is already installed.
issues.patch-server-stale: The room address changed after the patch was made.

worlds-incompatible.title: Incompatible worlds

worlds-incompatible.problem: Some worlds are not compatible with your Archipelago version.

worlds-shadowed.title: Duplicate worlds
worlds-shadowed.problem: Some worlds exist twice: only one copy is used.

worlds-bad-name.ok: Every world is named after its inner folder.
worlds-bad-name.problem: Some worlds are not named after their inner folder: Archipelago does not load them. Rename them from the Worlds screen.

ap-processes.title: Open Archipelago programs
ap-processes.problem: Some Archipelago programs are open: close them before installing or changing settings.

port-38281.title: Port 38281
port-38281.ok: The default server port is free.
port-38281.problem: Port 38281 is already in use: a server may already be running.

bizhawk.title: BizHawk
bizhawk.problem: BizHawk or one of its prerequisites is missing (only needed for the games that use it).

disk-space.title: Disk space
disk-space.ok: There is enough disk space left.
disk-space.problem: Little disk space is left to install or generate.

programdata-acl.title: Archipelago folder permissions
programdata-acl.ok: The Archipelago folder permissions are normal.
programdata-acl.problem: Every account on this PC can change the C:\ProgramData\Archipelago folder.

glibc.title: C library (glibc)
glibc.problem: The glibc version is too old for Archipelago (2.35 at least).

chromium-sandbox.title: Chromium sandbox
chromium-sandbox.ok: The app runs inside Chromium’s sandbox.
chromium-sandbox.problem: The app runs without Chromium’s sandbox: this system restricts user namespaces (AppArmor). The README’s Linux section shows how to turn it back on (or use the .deb).

network.title: Connection and clock
network.ok: The connection works and the clock is right.
network.problem: No connection, or the clock is off: downloads may fail.

skipped.release-unavailable: Not checked: the latest release cannot be looked up right now.
skipped.version-unknown: Not checked: the installed Archipelago version cannot be read.
skipped.probe-failed: Not checked: the check itself failed ({{error}}).
